subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A device that can show everything should not always show everything.”?
options: People need the power to keep it working.
People need quiet spaces before the world enters.
People need to know what a chart means before fear fills the empty spaces.
Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「People need the power to keep it working.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A device that can show everything should not always show everything. People need quiet spaces before the world enters.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「People need to know what a chart means before fear fills the empty spaces.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A device that can show everything should not always show everything. People need quiet spaces before the world enters.」，答案為「People need quiet spaces before the world enters.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「People need quiet spaces before the world enters.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
